title: player-projections GET /projections response
description: What player-projections serves to the frontend. Player rows are $ref'd from the snapshot schema rather than restated, so the row shape has exactly one definition across the inbound and outbound contracts. This is a design-first contract: the frontend that consumes it does not exist yet.

format.description: Echoes the requested scoring mode, so a client can confirm what it got.

projections.description: Player rows in upstream order, optionally narrowed by the `pos` filter. Never null — an unpopulated or failing upstream yields an empty array with upstream_healthy false.

count.description: Length of `projections` AFTER filtering. `count == len(projections)` is the intended invariant; JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot compare siblings, so it is asserted in the consumer's tests.

last_updated.description: When this format's cache was last refreshed successfully. Null in stub mode or before the first successful poll.

upstream_healthy.description: False means the last poll for THIS format failed. Rows may still be present and stale — the cache is retained on failure, and no staleness bound is enforced yet.
